steps: Take a photo of your passport or ID card.
Check the details we read and complete a few more.
Read and accept the consent, then send.

photo.title: Photograph your document
tips: Use your passport (the page with your photo) or your national ID card.
Lay it flat, in good light, without glare or shadows.
Passport: include the two lines of letters and < signs at the bottom of the page.
Keep the whole document in the picture and the text sharp.
